item.title: 【General Music Discussion】Britney Spears - Get Naked (I Got a Plan) Dolby Atmox mix now censored?
item.description:
I was just listening to Get Naked (I Got a Plan) on Apple Music with Dolby Atmos, but the line 'I'm crazy as a motherf*cker, bet that on your man' got censored? I know I'm not the only one that remembers that two of Britney's songs became uncensored (this one and Blur from Circus) with the release of the Dolby Atmos mixes in Apple Music. Am I just the one?

I hope they don't do the same with Blur, and if they do, I'm gonna cry
item.author: iridescentrye
